# Basic bicycle maintenance

Most breakdowns on a bicycle start as small neglect: a dry chain, a soft tire, a worn pad.

## Chain

Wipe it, then put one drop of oil on each link and wipe off the excess. A clean chain shifts quietly and lasts thousands of kilometers more.

## Brakes and tires

Squeeze both levers before you leave: they should stop short of the bar. Pump the tires to the pressure printed on their side.
